_README: One entry per lodge. nightlyRate / cleaningFee / petFee are PLACEHOLDERS derived from public listing prices (Nov 2026) - set your own direct rates. Seasonal rates: add {from,to,nightlyRate} entries to 'seasons' (dates inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD). changeoverDays: 0=Sun,1=Mon..6=Sat; empty list = any day. Photos: put files in images/<lodge id>/ (full size) and images/<lodge id>/thumbs/ (about 640px), list them in 'images' (gallery order) and set 'cover' for the card image.

lodges.name: Aderyn Du
lodges.summary: A contemporary lodge for two with a double-height open-plan lounge, kitchen and dining area, a mezzanine super-king bedroom with countryside views, and a private hot tub on the enclosed balcony.
features: Private hot tub on enclosed balcony
Up to 2 dogs, enclosed dog paddock
Bike storage & on-site EV charger (extra cost)
lodges.priceNote: [Confirm price] Public listings show approx. £597-£981 per week.

lodges.name: Titw Tomos Las
lodges.summary: A single-storey lodge with a floor-to-ceiling feature glass wall, vaulted open-plan lounge/kitchen/diner, four super-king bedrooms (three zip-and-link) and a large enclosed deck with hot tub and charcoal BBQ.
features: Hot tub on large enclosed deck
lodges.priceNote: [Confirm price] Public listings show approx. £1,040-£2,973 per week.

lodges.name: Bwncath
lodges.tagline: Elevated lodge for six with valley views
lodges.summary: A single-storey lodge in an elevated spot with floor-to-ceiling glazing, open-plan living with breakfast bar, three bedrooms (two en-suite), a Jack-and-Jill bathroom with freestanding bath, and a decked terrace with hot tub, BBQ and outdoor shower.
features: Hot tub, BBQ & outdoor shower on decked terrace
Bed linen, towels, fuel & power included
lodges.priceNote: [Confirm price] Public listings show from approx. £1,023-£1,062 for 7 nights.

lodges.name: Barcud Coch
lodges.tagline: Four-bedroom lodge for eight on a working farm
lodges.summary: A detached single-storey lodge on a working farm with open-plan living, underfloor heating, four bedrooms (two en-suite), a Jack-and-Jill bathroom with freestanding bath, an enclosed lawned garden and a terrace with hot tub, BBQ and outdoor shower.
lodges.priceNote: [Confirm price] Public listings show approx. £1,269 for 7 nights (sample date).
